evidence.name: Screen field: Grid cell proportions
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Grid cell proportions" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Grid cell proportions
sections.description: Sets each grid cell's height as a percentage of its width: 100 is square, above 100 makes taller cells, below 100 makes wider, shorter cells. Pick taller cells for image-led options and square for balanced icon-and-text choices. Only appears on two-column grids — try 100 first, then adjust to fit your content.
